aeternum.config.language.tip: The language of all Aeternum mods. Auto uses the same language as Minecraft.
aeternum.config.theme.tip: The same for all Aeternum mods: change it here and they all change.
aeternum.config.theme_reset.tip: Brings back the starting Aeternum theme. Your own colours are removed.
aeternum.config.theme_link.tip: The theme and colours are chosen in Vernis. It changes all Aeternum mods at once.
aeternum.config.follows_global.tip: Vernis is installed, so colours and window shape are set there, for all mods at the same time.
aeternum.config.style_link.tip: Outlines, colour line, text shadow, contrast and see-through. All set in Vernis.
aeternum.config.radius.tip: Rounds the corners of windows and buttons in all Aeternum mods. 0 = square corners.
aeternum.config.stroke.tip: The line around windows, buttons and fields. With no line, you see them by their colour.
aeternum.config.rule.tip: The colour line at the top of windows: small on the left, full width, or no line.
aeternum.config.shadow.tip: A shadow around windows, so they stand out over the game.
aeternum.config.backdrop.tip: Makes the game darker behind mod windows. At 0 %, the game stays normal.
aeternum.config.panel.tip: Below 100 %, you can see the game a bit through windows. Menus that open stay solid.
aeternum.config.style_reset.tip: Brings back the starting shape: square corners, thin line, no shadow. Colours don't change.
aeternum.config.round_hud.tip: Also rounds what stays square while you play: Tiered Bars' hunger bar, Chest Radar's dial, Arpenteur's map markers.
aeternum.config.density.tip: The space around things in windows. Tight hides a bit less of the game.
aeternum.config.selection.tip: How you see what you picked in a list or menu: a bar on the left, a coloured background or an underline.
aeternum.config.text_shadow.tip: A shadow under text so it's easier to read. On the game: only text drawn over the world. Everywhere: panel text too (board, minimap, Chest Radar).
aeternum.config.contrast.tip: Makes grey text (descriptions, values) lighter or darker. 50 % keeps the theme's colours.
aeternum.config.page.appearance.subtitle: One theme for all %s mods. You see the result right away.
aeternum.config.themes.tip: Each theme changes the background, the boxes and the main colour. You can change the main colour just below.
aeternum.config.saved_theme.tip: The themes you created in Vernis.
aeternum.config.accent.tip: The colour of buttons, gauges and what you picked. The + lets you pick any colour.
aeternum.config.rounding.tip: Rounds the corners of cards and buttons.
aeternum.config.depth.tip: Flat: with outlines. Layered: with colour steps and a shadow.
